reason: I just lost two waiters and I'm still short-staffed. The last thing I need is to change how the bill and tips work and risk the ones I have left walking out. And my regulars already know me by name, so I don't need an app or a loyalty reward to keep them.
objection: My waiters will see QR payment as a threat to their tips and their table time, and I can't afford to upset them right now. A 30-minute training doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from a few other owners in Sololaki or Vake whose waiters actually earned more tips with QR, plus a Keepz fee in writing that's clearly lower than my terminal. And I'd want to try it once I'm fully staffed again.
